data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: will you choose 18? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. This risks future income; it isn't a guaranteed long-run optimum.
